set.body:
OIDC code flow with PKCE, server sessions in a protected cookie, provider identity bound to a principal. Related: F04.1, F04.2. Prefer a small development provider in the compose file.
Done when: a person signs in through the provider and is chosen by name in a share.

Source: docs/build-plan.md, section 8, package 6.
set.title: D06: Institutional sign-in, sessions and a people directory
